BootstrapBlazor.Server.Components.Sample.OpcDaDescription: Connect to OpcDa Server to obtain PLC real-time data
BootstrapBlazor.Server.Components.Sample.OpcDaNormalIntro: Get an instance by injecting the service IOpcDaClient and call the Read method to get the PLC Tag value.
BootstrapBlazor.Server.Components.Sample.RegisterServiceText: Register the BootstrapBlazor.OpcDa service (this service only supports Windows; for cross-platform scenarios, use the OpcUa service instead)
BootstrapBlazor.Server.Components.Sample.Step1Text: 1. Click the Connect button to establish communication with the OpcDa server
BootstrapBlazor.Server.Components.Sample.Step2Text: 2. Click the Read button to read tag values from the OpcDa server
BootstrapBlazor.Server.Components.Sample.Step3Text: Through subscription, you can monitor changes in a group of tag data and notify subscribers through the DataChanged callback when data changes
BootstrapBlazor.Server.Components.Sample.Step4Text: Call the Browse method of OpcDaClient to build a tree structure of nodes

BootstrapBlazor.Server.Components.Sample.OpcUaDescription: Connect to a server through OPC UA and access real-time data
BootstrapBlazor.Server.Components.Sample.OpcUaNormalIntro: Configure an OPC UA endpoint to connect, read, subscribe, and browse nodes
BootstrapBlazor.Server.Components.Sample.Step1Text: 1. Click Connect to connect to the OPC UA server
BootstrapBlazor.Server.Components.Sample.Step2Text: 2. Enter a node ID to read its value
BootstrapBlazor.Server.Components.Sample.Step3Text: Subscribe to a node to receive notifications when its value changes
BootstrapBlazor.Server.Components.Sample.Step4Text: Browse the node structure of the OPC UA server

BootstrapBlazor.Server.Components.Sample.AdaptersDescription: Receive data through the data adapter and display
BootstrapBlazor.Server.Components.Sample.NormalIntro: After the connection is established, the timestamp data sent by the server is received through the ReceivedCallBack callback method of the DataPackageAdapter data adapter.
After connecting, the timestamp data sent by the server is automatically received through the ReceivedCallBack callback method
BootstrapBlazor.Server.Components.Sample.ReceivesDescription: Receive data through ReceivedCallBack and display it

BootstrapBlazor.Server.Components.Sample.AutoReconnectsDescription: Receive data through the data adapter and display

BootstrapBlazor.Server.Components.Sample.NormalIntro: After the connection is established, the data sent by the server is received through the ReceiveAsync callback method. The data problems of sticking and splitting packets need to be handled by the client.
BootstrapBlazor.Server.Components.Sample.ReceivesDescription: Receive data through call ReceiveAsync and display it

BootstrapBlazor.Server.Components.Sample.TablesDynamicDynamicColIntro: Dynamic adjustment of the DataTable table component automatically updates via code
BootstrapBlazor.Server.Components.Sample.TablesDynamicEditDescription: By setting the OnChanged callback method of the DataTableDynamicContext instance, the value is automatically set when a new row is created
BootstrapBlazor.Server.Components.Sample.TablesDynamicNoteP1: The DataTableDynamicContext object internally uses Emit to convert DataTable rows into dynamic types, so every time a DataTableDynamicContext is created a dynamic assembly is generated under the hood. In real projects you should avoid creating dynamic assemblies repeatedly
BootstrapBlazor.Server.Components.Sample.TablesDynamicNoteP2: You can set the UseCache="false" property of DataTableDynamicContext to disable the internal data cache, and update the DataTable property of DataTableDynamicContext in your own code logic to greatly improve system performance
BootstrapBlazor.Server.Components.Sample.TablesDynamicNoteP3: You can refer to the pagination table sample code. Use CreatePageDataContext to create the DataTableDynamicContext instance. When clicking the pager, only the data is updated, and there is no need to recreate the DataTableDynamicContext instance

BootstrapBlazor.Server.Components.Sample.TablesDynamicExcelDescription: Commonly used for large data sheet maintenance
BootstrapBlazor.Server.Components.Sample.TablesDynamicExcelEnumIntro: Set the column Items value, and render the enum type into a Select component
BootstrapBlazor.Server.Components.Sample.TablesDynamicExcelEnumTip: Use the above code to render the Education column using the Select component
BootstrapBlazor.Server.Components.Sample.TablesDynamicExcelKeyboardIntro: This example is used to test keyboard support in Excel mode
BootstrapBlazor.Server.Components.Sample.TablesDynamicExcelKeyboardTips1_note1: Set the TItem property of the Table component to DynamicObject
BootstrapBlazor.Server.Components.Sample.TablesDynamicExcelKeyboardTips1_note2: Set the DynamicContext property of the Table component to the DataTableDynamicContext instance
BootstrapBlazor.Server.Components.Sample.TablesDynamicExcelKeyboardTips1_note3: Set the Enum type to render to Select
BootstrapBlazor.Server.Components.Sample.TablesDynamicExcelKeyboardTips2_note1: Set the OnChanged callback delegate function to handle the New/Delete logic
BootstrapBlazor.Server.Components.Sample.TablesDynamicExcelKeyboardTips3_note1: Set the OnValueChanged callback delegate function to handle the cell update logic
BootstrapBlazor.Server.Components.Sample.TablesDynamicExcelKeyboardTips3_note4: The internal method updates the original data source DataTable
BootstrapBlazor.Server.Components.Sample.TablesDynamicExcelKeyboardTips_DatTable: When using DatTable as the data source, you need to follow the steps below to set
BootstrapBlazor.Server.Components.Sample.TablesDynamicExcelKeyboardTips_IsExcel: After the IsExcel mode is enabled, some parameters will no longer take effect, and the zebra IsStriped tree table IsTree has more detail lines IsDetails Select column IsMultipleSelect
BootstrapBlazor.Server.Components.Sample.TablesDynamicExcelNormalDescription: When the binding is dynamic type in Excel mode, TableColumn cannot be used to set column properties. In this example is used DynamicContext Instance object DataTableDynamicContext constructor to set
BootstrapBlazor.Server.Components.Sample.TablesDynamicExcelNormalIntro: Make the component render like Excel by setting the table's IsExcel property

BootstrapBlazor.Server.Components.Sample.TaskBoardNormalIntro: This component provides detailed information about background task schedule trigger.
